plan.notes: Source: official Penn State University Bulletin, College of Engineering, 'Computer Science, B.S. (Engineering)' page, section 'Suggested Academic Plan -> Computer Science, B.S. at University Park Campus (CMPSC_BS)', in effect for the 2026-27 academic year. Transcribed term-by-term directly from the official table; no courses, credits, or prereqs invented. Bulletin states a minimum of 127 credits for the B.S. and a plan total of 127-130. Credit ranges in the bulletin (MATH 220: 2-3; Natural Science GN elective: 2-3; Spring Year 2 General Education Course: 3-4) are recorded at their lower bounds so the plan totals exactly 127, the stated degree minimum. Prereqs included only where officially documented (CMPSC 122/132 requires CMPSC 121/131; CMPSC 221 requires CMPSC 122/132, per the EECS Undergraduate Handbook course sequence) and are referenced to the plan's choice-slot codes; all other prereq fields are intentionally left empty rather than inferred. Entrance-to-major (University Park): CMPSC 121/131, CMPSC 122/132, MATH 140, MATH 141, PHYS 211 with C or better plus 3.20 cumulative GPA. STAT 318/319 transcribed as shown in the suggested plan; the bulletin requirements list also allows STAT/MATH 414 or 418 in place of 318, and STAT/MATH 415 in place of 319. Bulletin footnotes: (*) requires grade of C or better for the major; (#) entrance to major; (dagger) satisfies General Education and degree requirement; elective footnotes 1 and 2 point to the Computer Science Undergraduate Handbook for the 400-level and department-list elective lists. Beaver, Brandywine, and Hazleton use a separate suggested plan (CSENG_BS); only the University Park plan is transcribed here.
